risks: Marubeni and American Airlines have made pre-delivery payments for conditional pre-orders, but final terms must be agreed upon.
Vertical Aerospace may face delays in production due to supply chain disruptions, particularly with key suppliers Aciturri and Honeywell.
Vertical Aerospace must comply with various trade control laws and may need export licenses for its products.
Vertical Aerospace could face significant fines and other legal consequences under GDPR and U.K. GDPR.
Vertical Aerospace may lose its foreign private issuer status in the future, which could result in significant additional costs and expenses.

growth_drivers: American Airlines committed to pay a pre-delivery payment for 50 aircraft.
Vertical Aerospace completed the first-ever wingborne flight of an electric VTOL aircraft in May 2025.
risks: Vertical Aerospace needs additional capital to continue operations beyond mid-2026.
The company may be unable to realize its assets and discharge its liabilities in the normal course of business due to potential capital exhaustion.
Achievement of technical milestones is crucial for securing additional financing.

growth_drivers: Vertical Aerospace demonstrated its aircraft at the Farnborough International Airshow.
Vertical Aerospace completed the first ever eVTOL flying display at Farnborough.
Vertical Aerospace partnered with Near Earth Autonomy for its Valo platform.
Vertical Aerospace is developing a compact, cost-efficient charging solution for electric aircraft.
Valo's U.K.-European pathway is being designed for global reach, with certification expected in 2029.
risks: The U.K. government will provide up to $30.5 million in grants, bringing total support to approximately $100 million.

growth_drivers: Vertical Aerospace has received high profile order announcements in the last few months.
Vertical Aerospace is developing a hybrid aircraft with a gas turbine system, opening up defense options.
Vertical Aerospace is installing a hybrid powertrain into Aircraft 3, expected to perform a transition flight in Q1 or early Q2 next year.
Vertical Aerospace is developing a proprietary charging system for its electric aircraft.
Vertical Aerospace plans to demonstrate the hybrid powertrain next year.
risks: Vertical Aerospace is very selective with customers, which may limit order volume.
